PROJECTS

PROJECT_01

DIY RACING SIMULATOR

A custom-built racing simulator featuring a self-fabricated force-feedback steering wheel, handmade pedals, and a full electronics bay. Built with an Arduino-driven motor controller for the FFB motor, custom button box, and integrated with PC sim racing software.

Arduino Force Feedback Motor Control PWM DIY Hardware HID Interface

PROJECT_02

SUMOBOT

A competitive mini sumobot for the 500g class. Features IR sensors for opponent detection, a low-profile wedge chassis, and Bluetooth/BLE wireless control via a custom Web Bluetooth HTML interface using Nordic UART Service. Engineered for aggressive ring dominance.

ESP32 BLE IR Sensors Motor Driver Web Bluetooth C++

PROJECT_03

HX-1 ROVER WITH ROBOTIC ARM

Multi-mode autonomous robot with a 6-DOF robotic arm. The architecture uses an Orange Pi One (Armbian Linux) as the main computer, ESP32 WROOM-32 as the real-time PS4 Bluetooth controller, and an Arduino Pro Mini as a dedicated sensor node. Modes include Manual, Sumobot, Hockey Bot, Obstacle Avoidance, and Maze Solver — all selectable via DIP switches. Features live webcam streaming, OLED status display, PCA9685 servo driver, and signal LEDs.

ESP32 Orange Pi Arduino Pro Mini Bluepad32 (PS4) PCA9685 I2C / UART L298N HC-SR04 mjpg-streamer C++ / Python Linux
